description:
Comparison pages ordered by how long ago their competitor facts were last verified, oldest first. Pass `before` (ISO date) to return only pages last verified before that date. Each page shows its verification date publicly, so keeping these fresh matters.

Parameters:
- before (string, optional): Only pages whose reviewed date is on or before this ISO date (optional).

Returns: paginated comparisons objects with url per item.

before.description: Only pages whose reviewed date is on or before this ISO date (optional).

name: needs_review

has_more.description: True when total > offset + count(items); call again with offset += limit to paginate.

items.description: Matching comparisons objects, each decorated with a `url` field where the collection has a public URL pattern configured. Field set varies by collection — call describe_collection for the schema.

url.description: Public URL for this object when the collection has a URL pattern configured.

limit.description: Cap applied to this response — server may have lowered the requested limit.
